name: Takatsukasa Rideru
source: The heroine of the story and a daughter of Arisu Takatsukasa. Rideru has crush on Kuu since childhood but due to a misunderstanding, result in a fight and Kuu ran away to work at Summer Radish Restaurant. In order to win back his heart, Rideru decided to work there too.
